name: 品牌果园 · Solarpunk Orchard
description: RepoChan's own solarpunk-orchard landing page: a sunrise orchard hero scene (baked L1+L2 with a live-text safe zone), a gardener cutout watering a sapling, six growth-stage sections (soil/seed/sprout/sunframe/harvest/share), a foundation plaque and a harvest basket of nine die-cut stickers. zh default locale with a full en edition; every visual is real pipeline output.

assets.description: Sunrise orchard hero scene with the project character gardening among young trees — baked L1+L2 landscape poster (3:2) with a soft morning-sky safe zone on the left/top for live title text. Reference is the raw 4K-class scene master.

brief.intent: Repaint the sunrise-orchard hero scene for the downstream project: the project character as a gardener tending a young tree in a warm daylight orchard, with a continuous soft sky/morning-light safe zone on the left and top for live headline text.
mustInclude: a sunrise orchard scene: warm golden morning light, gentle grassy slopes, a few trees with glowing fruit, simplified solar geometry (low photovoltaic flowers / a small windmill) on the horizon
the project character in a gardener pose (crouching and watering a sapling, or picking fruit on a ladder), fully inside the canvas with no cropped limbs
natural materials: light watercolor edges, paper-fiber feel, risograph green tones
a continuous soft sky/morning-light safe zone covering roughly the left 40% and top 30% — no high-frequency detail, no faces, able to carry headline text
a daylight-ecology palette led by warm gold, leaf green, moss and sky blue from the project identity
avoid: text, letters, watermarks, UI, screens, piles of electronic devices
the character's face inside the left safe zone
creativeFreedom: tree species and fruit shapes (fruit may subtly hint at brand assets)
the exact form of the horizon solar geometry
treatment of morning mist and light beams

assets.description: Full-body die-cut cutout of the character as a gardener watering a small sapling — the Sprout section's independent L2, transparent webp produced by chroma-key + compress. Reference is the raw matte master (2:3).

brief.intent: Regenerate the gardener cutout for the downstream project's character: holding a watering can and leaning slightly forward to water a small sapling, readable as a standalone die-cut layer beside live text.
mustInclude: one full-body character watering a small sapling with a watering can, fully inside the canvas with margins on all four sides — head to shoes, can and water arc complete, nothing cropped
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character, no shadows or gradients on the matte
single centered subject, front or slight 3/4 view, a caring expression
single-focus pose: the main hand holds the watering can, the other hand rests naturally — no complex two-handed action
avoid: complex background elements or a second character
creativeFreedom: watering-can design (a small brand-color detail is welcome)
small gardener outfit variations (e.g. rolled-up sleeves) as long as core identity markers stay intact

assets.description: Foundation sheet shown as a wooden plaque nailed to the tree in the Sunframe section — square 1:1, compressed to 1024px webp.

brief.intent: Regenerate the foundation sheet cover for the downstream project's character: palette, three views and signature accessories locked in one frame, presented as the orchard's sun-frame plaque.
mustInclude: the project character's foundation sheet: three views, palette swatches and signature accessories in one composition
square 1:1 framing that reads cleanly inside a wooden plaque frame

assets.description: Project icon — nav badge; also the favicon source (favicon.ico / apple-touch-icon.png / icon-192.png / icon-512.png are derived from it offline via compress + favicon + resize).

mustInclude: one scalable brand mark reading cleanly at 38px
creativeFreedom: accent colors from the project palette

assets.description: Waving cutout cameo on the Share Table CTA — transparent webp produced by chroma-key + compress. Reference is the raw matte master (1:1).

brief.intent: Regenerate the closing-CTA cutout for the downstream project's character: a friendly waving/presenting pose that reads while perched beside the share-table command card.
mustInclude: one full-body character waving or presenting, fully inside the canvas
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character

assets.description: Nine die-cut stickers — all nine cells run as the fruit in the Harvest section's basket (round fruit plates with stems and a hover sway). sticker-N.webp is cell N of the 3×3 grid; the source grid's cell semantics (chibi expressions) differ from the template's fixed keys, and the keys are the positional replacement contract for downstream regeneration.

mustInclude: strict 3×3 grid of the project character in the nine fixed web-state poses (template cell semantics)
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character, identical in every pixel outside the stickers
creativeFreedom: expression and pose details inside each fixed semantic
